name: Vyasa Maharshi Cave (Vyasa Guha)
description: The sacred cave where Sage Veda Vyasa is believed to have performed severe penance. Features an extremely narrow, steep stone entryway leading down to a small, subterranean meditation chamber.

name: Vedavathi Shila (Sri Vedavathi Stone)
description: An ancient, geological rock formation situated right opposite the Basara RTC Bus Stand. Local lore associates the stone with deep Vedic histories aligned with the temple genesis.

name: Sahastrakund Waterfalls
description: Strictly seasonal. The waterfall dries up significantly during peak summer months; your readers should only plan trips here post-monsoon (August to December).A majestic natural cascade where the river drops down stepped rock formations, creating a wide, visually striking field of rapids.

name: Ali Sagar Dam & Deer Park
description: A scenic reservoir built in 1930 featuring a massive 30-acre landscaped public park, an island treehouse for kids, a deer sanctuary enclosure, and broad-water boating facilities.
